office_does: The treasurer collects property taxes for the county and every local taxing district, banks and invests county funds, and pays county warrants.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Kenneth Spencer Jr. (Prefers Republican Party), treasurer since 2017, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Benton County Treasurer since 2017, a former college professor and longtime commercial appraiser; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Treasurer since 2017; precinct committee officer since 2012 [S1]
Calls safeguarding public funds the office's most important function and cites new efficiency software [S1]
Endorsed by the Benton County Republican Party [S1]
